claims.statement: John Dwyer said that if Tom Allen were brought over to America, Dwyer would, with his brother's consent, fight him for any sum up to $5,000 a side.
claims.excerpt: and fight him for any sum up to $5,000

quotes.speaker: John Dwyer
quotes.text: I shall, with my brother's consent, be willing to niget him and fight him for any sum up to $5,000.
quotes.topic: willing to fight Allen if brought over

notes: Dwyer's offer is conditional on Allen being brought over; the quote's first word is garbled in the OCR (printed as niget). Allen is not otherwise described.
